newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends easier vs dlr at 176.50/55.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends easier vs dlr at 176.50/55.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed easier against the dollar on Friday after tracking the dollar/mark cross all day, dealers said.
The unit remained at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid) for all but a brief period when strong buying interest prized it to five pips from the bid, dealers said.
The forint finished at 176.50/55, compared with an opening level of 176.24/29.

"The shorter Friday session meant someone was in a hurry to get their purchase in but it was not a significant move and the forint returned to the bid by the close," said Zsolt Tilimon of Citibank. "Otherwise it was a very silent session with the forint following the dollar/mark cross."
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar..
